effects.name: Speed 0
effects.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

effects.name: Saving Throws Affected
effects.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

effects.name: Attacks Affected
effects.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

effects.name: Automatic Critical Hits
effects.text: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
